title: OOES-18: An Open Deterministic Evidence Schema for EU Regulation 2024/3015 and French DELTA IE (H1) Pre-Clearance
description: OOES-18 is an open, deterministic evidence schema for cross-border manufacturing orders. It defines 18 evidentiary slots across five layers, a three-valued epistemic lattice (UNKNOWN, ASSERTED, CORROBORATED), two deterministic release gates, Ed25519 attestation signatures with a relying-party trust store, and a salted blind-index protocol for cross-tenant duplicate-pledge detection. The repository contains the specification, Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema, deterministic test vector, TypeScript reference verifier, 17-test suite, and test trust store. The written specification is licensed CC-BY-4.0; the schema, code, tests, vector, and trust store are licensed Apache-2.0.
notes: The written specification (README.md and spec/) is CC-BY-4.0. The schema, test vector, reference verifier, tests, and test trust store are Apache-2.0. The test trust store contains public test keys only and must not be used in production.
